mapper.sql: c.id, c.travel_plan_id, c.sender_member_id, c.message_type, c.content, c.system_event_type, c.deleted_at, c.created_at, m.display_name AS sender_display_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_plan_chat_messages (travel_plan_id, sender_member_id, message_type, content, client_request_id) VALUES (#{travelPlanId}, #{senderMemberId}, #{messageType}, #{content}, #{clientRequestId})

INSERT INTO travel_plan_chat_read_positions (travel_plan_id, member_id, last_read_message_id, last_read_at) VALUES (#{travelPlanId}, #{memberId}, #{lastReadMessageId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_read_message_id = GREATEST( COALESCE(last_read_message_id, 0), #{lastReadMessageId}), last_read_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM travel_plan_chat_messages c WHERE c.travel_plan_id = #{travelPlanId} AND c.message_type = 'USER' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND (c.sender_member_id IS NULL OR c.sender_member_id <> #{memberId})
AND c.id > #{lastReadMessageId}
